description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-10-28)

### ✨ New Features

* DHU adapter patches (Morphe port of zeekr-adapt) ([67eb24b](https://github.com/mormislaw/zeekr-adapt-morphe-patches/commit/67eb24bf0c7abadbdccd7b182a0f4c0178fdbfc0))

patches.name: DHU adapter
patches.description: Adapts the app to an automotive head unit (Zeekr DHU) with a high resolution screen that reports a low density: readable single-DPI scaling, floating back/settings button and the opt-in compatibility fixes of zeekr-adapt. Uses Pine framework hooks installed from android:appComponentFactory before Application.onCreate. Preset: root, emulator, network and SIM gate bypass, Zeekr MediaCenter.

options.description: Category 1. Raises the density the app perceives, recomputes screen dp from the real usable pixels, unlocks orientation, adds the floating back/settings button, rounded corners, WebView text zoom and user agent. Disable for a bare shell (--no-display).
Density used for DisplayMetrics (rendering). Bigger means a larger UI. Keep it equal to the layout DPI. Can also be changed at runtime in the settings panel.
Density written into Configuration (resource and layout selection). zeekr-adapt keeps it equal to the rendering DPI, a split density breaks fixed-size views.
Turns every Activity.setRequestedOrientation call into UNSPECIFIED, so portrait-locked apps follow the landscape head unit (--no-orientation disables it).
Hides the system bars in every activity. Off by default, the dp recompute accounts for the visible bars.
Draggable floating button in every activity. Tap: back, long press: settings panel (DPI, button size, alpha, color, restart).
The button shows the current DPI and a tap opens the settings panel instead of going back.
Size of the floating button, 24 to 96 dp.
Opacity of the floating button, 0.05 to 1.0.
Color of the floating button as #RRGGBB.
Clips the activity content to rounded corners.
Radius of the rounded corners.
File name of a font inside the app's assets/fonts/ to apply to every TextView. Empty: off.
Returned by WebSettings.getDefaultUserAgent. Fixes web-rendered maps rejected by tile servers. Empty: keep the system user agent.

Category 2. Hides root and su from the app: Build.TAGS, File.exists, Runtime.exec, ProcessBuilder, PackageManager and root SystemProperties. For apps that refuse to run on rooted or userdebug head units.
Category 3. De-genericises Build.* and qemu/goldfish SystemProperties.

Category 4. isAutomotiveOS() and hasSystemFeature(automotive) return false, UiModeManager reports NORMAL, Configuration.uiMode loses CAR and the Android Auto connection query is blocked. Fixes the blank/white screen of car-aware apps.
Category 5a. NetworkCapabilities.hasCapability/hasTransport and NetworkInfo.isConnected report connected (head unit internet over Ethernet/TBOX without Android validation).
Category 5b. getSimState returns READY and key_use_cellular_data reads true. Harmful to SIM-aware apps such as phone number registration.

Category 6. Registers the app's MediaSession with ZeekrMediaCenterService: steering wheel control, cover art, metadata and reboot resume. Adds CoverProvider, RecoveryReceiver and the com.zeekr.mediacenter package query. Media apps only.
Category 7. Strips FLAG_SECURE so the screen can be captured or mirrored.
Category 8. Verbose logs, read with adb logcat -s DhuAdapter.
Category 9. Stores the genuine signer certificate of the original APK and returns it to the app's own signature self-check. Requires the original, store-signed APK.
